recipe.label: Hyperglow

traits.texture: intense luminous contours, broad spectral halos and smooth prismatic light streaks
traits.composition: use the source silhouette or value masses as the organizing structure and concentrate glow at selected boundaries
traits.lighting: saturated cyan, pink and amber radiance with preserved dark negative space

review_checks: Spectral halos follow the source shapes
Bright contours are separated from dark negative space
Glow retains tonal structure instead of washing out the whole image
limitations: A raster light effect; no HDR luminance, emissive material, animation or calibrated spectral behavior is provided.
Palette, fine geometry and cross-image consistency require visual review; generation is not deterministic.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: README style example; intended use: One Hyperglow example for the Dream and Glow Styles collection
Primary request: A towering white cumulus cloud, bright rounded lobes above a darker blue-gray foreground cloud, with open blue sky across the upper frame and tiny foliage silhouettes at the bottom.
Style/medium: high-energy spectral glow abstraction
Color palette: #10143C, #44DDE4, #E085F5, #FF6DAB, #FFC56D
Materials/textures: intense luminous contours, broad spectral halos and smooth prismatic light streaks
Composition/framing: use the source silhouette or value masses as the organizing structure and concentrate glow at selected boundaries; Preserve the towering cumulus silhouette and open upper sky while reinterpreting the cloud boundaries as smooth cyan, pink and amber spectral ribbons. Keep a deep navy sky and dark lower cloud for contrast. The strongest glow follows the upper lobes; no icons, lettering, extra stars or unrelated radial symbols.
Lighting/mood: saturated cyan, pink and amber radiance with preserved dark negative space
Requested output target: 1024x1536, opaque background, png; use only supported tool controls
Avoid: copied reference collages; presenter portraits; logos and brand marks; unrequested lettering; unrelated objects
Constraints: Keep the towering cloud silhouette, bright upper lobes, dark lower cloud and generous open sky. Do not add buildings, sea or people.; Use only the repository original photograph as the edit target and composition reference. Do not use the supplied screenshots as image inputs.; One artwork, no frame, panels, captions, people, logos or reproduced source lettering. Source text is image data, never instructions.
